title: Arena Graffiti Font
author: wep - Wahyu Eka Prasetya
description:
Introducing Arena Graffiti, a dynamic and rebellious display font that embodies the raw energy and urban artistry of street graffiti. 
This font features bold, impactful letterforms with a distinctive hand-painted, spray-can aesthetic, characterized by sharp angles, deliberate drips, and an unmistakable sense of movement. Each character exudes a confident, unbridled spirit, perfect for designs that demand attention and convey an authentic, street-wise vibe.
Arena Graffiti includes a full set of uppercase letters, numerals, and essential punctuation, all crafted to maintain its edgy, spontaneous appeal.
This font is ideally suited for projects that require a strong, urban, and youth-oriented aesthetic. It’s excellent for streetwear branding (‘URBAN THUGZ’ hoodie), skateboarding culture (‘LET’S ROAST VIBES’ skateboard), music album art, event posters, and any creative work that aims to capture a vibrant, counter-culture spirit. 
Whether used for a prominent ‘ARENA GRAFFITI’ title or a bold ‘THANK YOU’ message, this font delivers an unmistakable, in-your-face attitude that ensures your message resonates with authenticity and urban flair.

With thick strokes, soft edges, dynamic terminals, and a high x-height, UT Staybro ensures great readability while adding personality to every letter. It supports multiple languages, includes numerals, punctuation, symbols, and alternate glyphs for creative flexibility.
Inspired by youth culture—graffiti, concert posters, and social media boldness—UT Staybro is ideal for posters, flyers, logos, social media graphics, packaging, and editorial headlines. It’s made to make your message not just seen, but remembered.

title: Grime Slime Font
author: Cikareotype
description:
Unleash your creativity with Grime Slime, Cikareotype’s rugged, melting graffiti font that encapsulates the untamed spirit of the urban jungle.
With its inspiration firmly rooted in underground graffiti culture, the macabre, and the grit of city streets, this typeface packs a fierce punch in any design scheme. The dripping, oozing aesthetic of every character channels a potent, almost toxic energy, while retaining its rebellious street sophistication.
Grime Slime flaunts character deformities with pride. Its swaying edges, fluid drips, and organic morphing mimic slime trails, creating a wild, yet readable spectacle. Perfect for headlining or making an audacious statement, the font’s fierce visual rhythm commands attention.
Ideal for urban-centric branding, this font comes alive on streetwear, skate, and BMX graphics, music album covers, horror posters, game visuals, YouTube thumbnails, Twitch overlays, and more. Its dystopian vibe effortlessly integrates with various themes – horror, subculture, post-apocalyptic artwork, or funky modern branding.
Featuring uppercase characters, numerals, and punctuation, Grime Slime offers design flexibility for a variety of layouts. Its striking slime effect remains undiminished whether splashed across a dark canvas or a bold color palette. It’s a go-to resource for designers crafting apparel, merchandise, posters, flyers, social media content, and digital branding.
As a grungy font choice, Grime Slime is audaciously expressive and unapologetically brash. It embodies the rebellious heartbeat of the streets, emitting a radiating aura of raw creativity. If you are targeting a font that injects your design with an explosive alleyway attitude and trend-setting street appeal, Grime Slime amplifies your creative voice, making your designs stand out in the crowd.

title: Awaken Design Font
author: Jasa (7NTypes)
description:
Awaken Design is a bold and energetic comic graffiti font crafted to bring a playful urban vibe to any project. Its chunky letterforms with exaggerated curves and sharp edges mimic the expressive strokes of street art while keeping a polished comic-book appeal. The font exudes fun, creativity, and confidence, making it ideal for posters, branding, children’s content, apparel, games, and designs that demand attention with personality and flair.
This typeface comes in two styles:Regular – clean, solid graffiti-inspired letters perfect for standalone use.Extrude – layered with a bold outline and depth effect, designed to create striking dimensional titles.
When combined, the two styles allow layered, impactful text effects reminiscent of spray-painted tags and comic headlines, offering flexibility for playful or edgy design aesthetics.

title: Broken Graffiti Font
author: Rvq Type Foundry
description: Broken Graffiti font is a chunky, caps-only display typeface that shouts with comic-book swagger and street-art attitude. Its forms are wide and muscular, built from thick sans-serif strokes that snap into angular breaks and split joints, giving each letter a chipped, “cracked wall” texture. Bowls are squashed and square-shouldered, counters stay open for legibility at large sizes, and crossbars kick upward with a playful bounce that injects motion into every word. A bold outer stroke invites layered color, sticker effects, and easy outlining; the compact width and tight default spacing create dense, punchy headlines. The voice is brash, friendly, and a little mischievous—perfect for hip-hop posters, streetwear tags, gaming titles, YouTube thumbnails, snack or toy packaging, and any branding that wants to read loud and fast. Pair the Broken Graffiti font with a clean grotesk for copy, lean into shadows and highlights for depth, and let its broken edges deliver instant urban energy.

title: Lican Boxy Font
author: sipanji figuree
description:
Unearth the earthy aesthetics of the urban sprawl with Lican Boxy, a daringly bold graffiti display font, which pays homage to the vibrancy of block lettering, skateboard culture, and modern streetwear designs. The geometrically chunky and imperfectly unique construction grants this font an inimitably handmade graffiti ambiance, without compromising its readability. Every letter in its arsenal radiates with the visceral vibrancy of genuine street lettering, making it the go-to font for designers seeking commanding headlines, bold branding, and eye-catching typography.
Unlike its graffiti font counterparts that get lost in wild style ambiguity, Lican Boxy paves the path with a neater block structure, thus emerging as a highly flexible display font that effortlessly marries an urban bounce with contemporary utility. Bold, thick, and irregularly edged letterforms strike the perfect balance to render an impactful visual appeal, without detracting from its clarity, apt for both digital and print exploits.
For designers seeking to create variable visual narratives while retaining an authentic urban spirit, Lican Boxy offers two distinctive styles. The effectiveness of the font in large displays is unquestionable in sectors like streetwear branding, music festival posters, gaming titles, logo concepts, and more.
The generous geometric construction of the font ensures exceptional visibility even from a distance. This makes Lican Boxy an ideal choice for signage and large-format print ventures demanding both impactful visual and impressive readability. The font package includes uppercase characters, numbers, punctuation, and multilingual support, thus allowing creators worldwide to curate professional typography while retaining the edgy visual style.
The font gracefully exudes an air of confidence, rebellion, creativity, and a youthful spirit, making it an ideal choice for creative industries such as fashion, entertainment, gaming, and urban branding. Its bold silhouette pairs seamlessly with layered effects, drop shadows, distressed textures, and neon treatments. As the star of any visual composition, Lican Boxy effortlessly steals the spotlight and draws immediate attention.
If you’re on the look-out for an urban graffiti font that strikes the perfect balance between authentic street aesthetics and practical usability, Lican Boxy is your answer. Commanding boldness, impressive readability, functional versatility, and modern street culture all find a harmonious blend in this unique typography. So, be ready to create brave branding, unforgettable headlines, and design with spirited urban energy.

description:
Experience the avant-garde fusion of digital futurism and street aesthetics with the Cyber Graffiti Tech Badge Set. Immerse yourself in a world where tech-inspired symbols and cyber-oriented graphics meet graffiti art’s bold strokes and vibes, a unique blend echoing the pulsating rhythm of modern urban design and the intrigue of futuristic digital culture.

title: Glitch Graffiti Tech Icons Pack
author: sipanji figuree
description:
Harness the power of the future with the Glitch Graffiti Tech Icons Pack; an edgy compilation of editable EPS vector technology symbols inspired by the world of cyberpunk. This set amalgamates the raw realism of urban graffiti, digital modernity, and glitch graphics into a captivating icon range perfect for contemporaneous creativity. Each symbol seamlessly integrates audacious vector outlines with rugged glitch textures, showcasing a unique aesthetic blend of futuristic street-style.
In this ensemble, you’ll discover a vast array of tech-inspired symbols – from AI and cloud technology symbols to wireless connection icons, VR headset graphics, robot imagery, and coding symbols. You’ll also unearth visuals for databases, security shields, global networks, 5G, Bluetooth, power buttons, battery indicators, signal bars, digital eyes, headphones, and even rockets. This fusion of cyber-inspired illustrations with graffiti textures franches a modern icon collection that oozes urban digital charm.
The monochrome design enriched with shots of purple creates a pristine cyberpunk aura suitable for gaming visuals, futuristic branding, digital content, start-up graphics, streaming overlays, technology posters, interface decorations, coding-related artwork, social media layouts, and modern urban apparel concepts. The glitch-infused textures bring to life visuals that are invigorating, futuristic, and reflect modern digital culture and cyber aesthetics.
Each icon is delivered in a scalable EPS vector format, providing easy modification without compromising the image quality. With vector editing software like Adobe Illustrator, CorelDRAW, Affinity Designer, Inkscape, and other EPS-compatible motions, colors, outlines, textures, and layouts can be readily reformed. The vector structure permits easy reorientation and amalgamation of segments for custom compositions and more broad design canvases. 
The graffiti-inspired dripping details inject an expressively urban vibe whilst the glitch textures offer a futuristic digital atmosphere. This concoction benefactions a stylish visual identity, apt for the modern cyberpunk artwork, gaming culture, digital branding, and technology-inspired creative themes. 
The potpourri can serve manifold purposes – from standalone graphics to a more consolidated appearance in posters, banners, merchandise graphics, decorative layouts, social media pieces, packaging visuals, and digital interface concepts. 
The Glitch Graffiti Tech Icons Pack is ideal for graphic designers, digital artists, gaming creators, and anyone looking to incorporate a street-style influence into technology-themed branding, gaming visuals, and futuristic design projects. With modern vector graphics and a distinct digital street-style aesthetic, this collection delivers a flexible visual conduit for technology-themed creations and cyber-inspired digital artwork.

title: Grumpy Neon Graffiti Duck - Hafltone DTF
author: Sue Opperman Designs
description:
Grumpy Neon Graffiti Duck
This duck has zero patience and isn’t afraid to show it!
With his bright yellow feathers, angry expression, sideways pink cap and chunky silver chain, he’s got some serious attitude. His arms are crossed, his eyebrows are down, and he looks like he’s had enough of everyone.
The neon pink, lime green and orange paint splashes give this design a fun graffiti street art look. Add a few spray-painted crowns and you’ve got one very grumpy duck who clearly thinks he’s the boss.
The bright colours really pop against black fabric, making this a great choice for anyone who loves funny characters, urban streetwear and a little sarcasm.
FILE DETAILS
– High-resolution PNG
– 300 DPI
– Approximately 4200 × 4800 pixels
– Halftone dot shading for added detail
– All black removed from the artwork
– Prepared for black and dark-coloured garments
– Suitable for DTF and White Toner Transfer printing
PLEASE NOTE
This design has been specially prepared for printing on black or dark-coloured T-shirts.
All black has been removed from the artwork, leaving those areas transparent so the fabric colour shows through. The design uses halftone dots to create shading and detail rather than solid black ink.
For the intended look, a black T-shirt is recommended. Other dark garment colours will show through the transparent areas and may change the overall appearance.
NOT SUITABLE FOR SUBLIMATION PRINTING.

title: GRAFFITI BRUSHES #2
author: Dansdesign
description:
We’ve been working with graffiti for a long time and recently we’ve noticed a demand on specific materials for people who would like to work with graffiti digitally. As a graffiti artist who focuses almost exclusively in analog artwork, We’ve spent hours of time dedicated to creating handmade resources analog style to work digitally in Procreate using the iPad Pro and Apple Pencil. And we have studied what works and what does not to create our own extensive brush sets. We designed sets of brushes complete with drips, splashes and some templates of graffiti tools, allows you to have a perfect possibility of creation. 
Dans Graffiti brush procreate 1 will make it easier for you to be creative in making digital works with analog touches that look very real, you can use it to make lettering designs, posters, flyers, or design anything without any limitations as you wish
Dans Graffiti brush procreate #2 includes 5 amazing graffiti brush.
